identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Back the resident Shepherd with a configured model

values.summary: Runtime v3 now creates a configured model-backed resident Shepherd, preloads and keeps its local model resident, reports provider/model health through the roster, and isolates provider degradation from global Runtime readiness.
actual_changes: Add validated one-or-many resident Shepherd provider, model, endpoint, and preload configuration.
Route governed Shepherd reasoning through the configured Ollama model while retaining native admission authority.
Preload and continuously recover resident Shepherd models without terminating or globally degrading the Runtime.
Expose non-secret provider/model identity and consistent model_loading, ready, and degraded roster health.
Deploy and restart the exact candidate on Wuji with qwen3:8b resident forever.
follow_ups: Do not bind execution until #617/#636 is merged into the selected base.
